plume:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a transparent 8-frame looping fire sprite sheet for a dark cyberpunk/occult roguelike, intended for actual 64-pixel game cells.
Input image 1 is ONLY an art-style reference: the approved red-robed game character. Do not draw that character or its clothing.
Primary request: hand-painted / inked comic-style fire, with the SAME crisp edges, compact solid shapes, restrained dark outlines and decisive flat shadows as the reference. Eight consecutive frames of one fierce upright flame plume licking upward from the same fixed floor anchor. Flame silhouette must visibly change between frames but its base, size and position stay consistent, suitable for a seamless animation loop.
Layout: exactly 4 columns and 2 rows of equally sized cells, all eight cells occupied, chronological left to right then next row. No lines, frames, numbers, writing, people, scenery, or objects. Transparent background everywhere around the painted flames. Keep every plume fully inside its own cell with ample empty gutters.
Each cell: fixed base at horizontal center, 88% cell height. Plume occupies about 72% cell height and 65% cell width. Several interlocking irregular tongues, a dark burnt-orange rim, broad red-orange body, flat warm-yellow inner flames, small ivory hottest patches near the base, a few solid charred wisps and tiny detached sparks. Rough asymmetry, natural sharp tapered tips, two or three broken edges. Subtle organic painted texture only where it remains readable at 64 px. Blackish edges should be thin, not a black silhouette.
Avoid: neon, smooth gradients, translucent ribbons, sinusoidal waves, wireframe curves, mathematical repetition, fuzzy glows, laser beams, circles, smooth vector logos, realistic photography, cartoony faces. The actual painted flame material must carry the effect; no halo.
Output: landscape or square sheet that can be sliced into exact 4x2 equal cells; true transparency preserved.
cone:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent eight-frame animation sprite sheet for Souffle de feu in a dark cyberpunk/occult roguelike with native 64px cells.
Input image 1 (red-robed character) is ONLY the approved comic art-style reference; image 2 is ONLY the new painted flame palette/edge/shape reference. No characters or clothing should appear.
Generate exactly eight chronological animation frames of a broad HORiZONTAL fire torrent moving LEFT TO RIGHT and spreading as a 90-degree fan. Thick interlocking painted flame masses, dark irregular burnt-orange edges, strong orange body, broad flat yellow-hot interior patches and tiny pale-ivory hottest streaks. The fire has weight and ragged tapering tongues, not transparent light.
Exact sheet layout: 4 columns by 2 rows, equal SQUARE cells, with eight contained frames, left-to-right chronological order then second row. Wide 2:1 overall canvas so each of the eight cells is square.
Every cell: same fixed narrow emitter at x=10%, y=50%; the orange fire spreads rightward to x=88%, widening up/down to y=12% and y=88%. Several long tongues make an uneven curved right edge. Keep geometry and anchor stable across all frames; animate folds, forked tips and wisps for a seamless loop. Transparent gaps cut between some tongues. A few tiny solid embers belong near the fire, kept inside the cell.
Style: crisp inked / hand-painted comic game art, the same meaningful edges and flat facets as the character reference and same red-orange/yellow flame material as the second reference. Enough broad simple colour masses for 64px readability. Thin restrained dark contours. No smooth gradients or glow; no symmetric triangle shape.
Constraints: truly transparent background. No text, numbers, borders, grids, white background, scenery, character, weapon, icon frame, drop shadow, circles, laser beams, smooth ribbon curves, geometrical haloes or realistic photography. No cropping between cells. All frames share scale and emitter location.
